narrative.summary: Same BGD Labs Aave Governance V3 pattern already tracked on Ethereum L1/Arbitrum/Base, real 1-day delay - and a THIRD chain sharing the identical 9-signer, 5-of-9 guardian committee already found on Arbitrum and Base.
narrative.detail: ~$496M TVL, ~87% of all of Plasma’s DeFi TVL - the dominant lender on this chain. The guardian Safe’s owner set was independently re-derived live and matches Arbitrum’s and Base’s own guardian committees exactly, byte for byte - the same 9 people can now cancel the emergency path on three separate chains.
